title: Rama warns Seetha of difficulties of staying in forest
introduction: In this chapter Rama describes various troubles of staying in forest and beseeches seetha not to go to forest
closing: || इति अयोध्य कान्दे रामयने ष्टाविंशः सर्गः ||
Thus complets twenty eighth chapter of Ayodhya Kaanda of Srimad Ramayana.

verses.devanagari:
सएवम् ब्रुवतीम् सीताम् धर्मज्ञो धर्म वत्सलः |
निवर्तन अर्थे धर्म आत्मा वाक्यम् एतत् उवाच ह
verses.iast:
saevam bruvatīm sītām dharmaGYo dharma vatsalaḥ |
nivartana arthe dharma ātmā vākyam etat uvāca ha
verses.translation: Thinking of difficulties one will be called upon to bear in the forest, Rama who was fond of righteousness did not form the idea of taking Sita who was speaking as aforesaid.

verses.devanagari:
सान्त्वयित्वा पुनस्ताम् तु बाष्पदूषितलोचनाम् |
निवर्तनार्थे धर्मात्मा वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह
verses.iast:
sāntvayitvā punastām tu bāśhpadūśhitalocanām |
nivartanārthe dharmātmā vākyametaduvāca ha
verses.translation: Soothening with kind words to Sita, when eyes were blemished with tears, the virtuous Rama spoke again as follows, for the purpose of waking her turn back.

glosses.meaning: when eyes were blemished with tears
for the purpose of making her turn back.

verses.devanagari:
सीते महा कुलीना असि धर्मे च निरता सदा |
इह आचर स्वधर्मम् त्वम् मा यथा मनसः सुखम्
verses.iast:
sīte mahā kulīnā asi dharme ca niratā sadā |
iha ācara svadharmam tvam mā yathā manasaḥ sukham
verses.translation: "Sita! Your are born in a high lineage, ever devoted to righteousness. Perform your own virtue here, which is agreable to my mind."

verses.devanagari:
सीते यथा त्वाम् वक्ष्यामि तथा कार्यम् त्वया अबले |
वने दोषा हि बहवो वदतः तान् निबोध मे
verses.iast:
sīte yathā tvām vakṣyāmi tathā kāryam tvayā abale |
vane doṣā hi bahavo vadataḥ tān nibodha me
verses.translation: "Oh Sita, the delicate! Do whatever I tell you. There are many inconveniencs in the forest. Know them from me."

glosses.meaning: the delicate! yathaa tathaa = whatever manner

verses.devanagari:
सीते विमुच्यताम् एषा वन वास कृता मतिः |
बहु दोषम् हि कान्तारम् वनम् इति अभिधीयते
verses.iast:
sīte vimucyatām eṣā vana vāsa kṛtā matiḥ |
bahu doṣam hi kāntāram vanam iti abhidhīyate
verses.translation: "Oh, Sita! Let your thought made about forest be given up. It is indeed said that forest with its wilderness is fraught with many dangers."

verses.devanagari:
हित बुद्ध्या खलु वचो मया एतत् अभिधीयते |
सदा सुखम् न जानामि दुह्खम् एव सदा वनम्
verses.iast:
hita buddhyā khalu vaco mayā etat abhidhīyate |
sadā sukham na jānāmi duhkham eva sadā vanam
verses.translation: This advice is given by me, keeping your welfare in view. I do not ever consider a forest as comfortable. It is always uncomfortable."

verses.devanagari:
गिरि निर्झर सम्भूता गिरि कन्दर वासिनाम् |
सिम्हानाम् निनदा दुह्खाः श्रोतुम् दुह्खम् अतः वनम्
verses.iast:
giri nirjhara sambhūtā giri kandara vāsinām |
simhānām ninadā duhkhāḥ śrotum duhkham ataḥ vanam
verses.translation: "The sounds created from waterfalls in hills and from lions resding in mountain caves are unpleasant to hear. That is why living in a forest in uncomfortable."

glosses.meaning: created from water falls in hills

verses.devanagari:
क्रीडमानाश्च विस्रब्धा मत्ताह् शून्ये महामृगाः |
दृष्ट्वा समभिवर्तन्ते सीते दुःखमतो वनम्
verses.iast:
krīḍamānāśca visrabdhā mattāh śūnye mahāmṛgāḥ |
dṛśhṭvā samabhivartante sīte duḥkhamato vanam
verses.translation: "Large wild animals which are fearless and intoxicated sporting in the desolate forest; come forward, after seeing. Oh, Sita! That is why living in forest is uncomfortable."

verses.devanagari:
सग्राहाः सरितश्चैव पङ्कवत्यश्च दुस्तराः |
मत्तैरपि गजैर्नित्यमतो दुःखतरम् वनम्
verses.iast:
sagrāhāḥ saritaścaiva paṇ^kavatyaśca dustarāḥ |
mattairapi gajairnityamato duḥkhataram vanam
verses.translation: "Even streams filled with crocodiles full of mire are difficult to be crossed by rut elephants also. Hence dwelling in a forest is always very much uncomfortable.

verses.devanagari:
लताकण्टकसम्पूर्णाः कृकवाकूपनादिताः |
निरपाश्च सुदुर्गाश्च मार्गा दुःखमतो वनम्
verses.iast:
latākaṇṭakasampūrṇāḥ kṛkavākūpanāditāḥ |
nirapāśca sudurgāśca mārgā duḥkhamato vanam
verses.translation: "Pathways covered with creepers and thorns, echoed with noise of wild cocks, are water-less and very difficult to enter. Hence dwelling in a forest is hardship."

glosses.meaning: echoed with noise of wild cocks

verses.devanagari:
सुप्यते पर्ण शय्यासु स्वयम् भग्नासु भू तले |
रात्रिषु श्रम खिन्नेन तस्मात् दुह्खतरम् वनम्
verses.iast:
supyate parṇa śayyāsu svayam bhagnāsu bhū tale |
rātriṣu śrama khinnena tasmāt duhkhataram vanam
verses.translation: "One distress by fatigue has to sleep in nights on a bed of fallen leaves. Hence, living in a forest is very much a misery."

glosses.meaning: on a bed of fallen leaves

verses.devanagari:
अहोरात्रम् च सन्तोषः कर्तव्यो नियतात्मना |
फलैर्वृक्षावपतितैः सीते दुःखमतो वनम्
verses.iast:
ahorātram ca santośhaḥ kartavyo niyatātmanā |
phalairvṛkśāvapatitaiḥ sīte duḥkhamato vanam
verses.translation: "Oh, Sita! With mind disciplined day and night, one has to necessarily satisfy ourself with fruits fallen from trees. Hence, living in a forest is a suffering."

verses.devanagari:
उपवासः च कर्तव्या यथा प्राणेन मैथिलि |
जटा भारः च कर्तव्यो वल्कल अम्बर धारिणा
verses.iast:
upavāsaḥ ca kartavyā yathā prāṇena maithili |
jaṭā bhāraḥ ca kartavyo valkala ambara dhāriṇā
verses.translation: "Oh, Sita the princess of Mithila! Fasting is to be done according to one's stamina. Clothes of bark are to be worn and mass of matted hair has to be worn on the head."

glosses.meaning: and mass of matted hair(on the head) kartavyaH = is to be done.

verses.devanagari:
देवतानाम् पितृइणाम् चकर्तव्यम् विधिपूर्वकम् |
प्राप्तानामतिथीनाम् च नित्यशः प्रतिपूजनम्
verses.iast:
devatānām pitṛiṇām cakartavyam vidhipūrvakam |
prāptānāmatithīnām ca nityaśaḥ pratipūjanam
verses.translation: "The celestials, the ancestors, the guests who arrive are to be worshipped always according to the preseribed rites."

verses.devanagari:
कार्यस्त्रीरभिषेकश्च काले काले च नित्यशः |
चरता नियमेनैव तस्माद्दुःखतरम् वनम्
verses.iast:
kāryastrīrabhiśhekaśca kāle kāle ca nityaśaḥ |
caratā niyamenaiva tasmādduḥkhataram vanam
verses.translation: "Bath is to be performed three times a day at appropriate time by the one moving in the forest, with one's mind kept in restraint. Hence, living in a forest is very much a misery."

glosses.meaning: by the one moving in the forest

verses.devanagari:
उपहारश्च कर्तव्यः कुसुमैः स्वयमाहृतैः |
आर्षेण विधिना वेद्याम् बाले दुःखमतो वनम्
verses.iast:
upahāraśca kartavyaḥ kusumaiḥ svayamāhṛtaiḥ |
ārśheṇa vidhinā vedyām bāle duḥkhamato vanam
verses.translation: "Oh, Sita the innocent! Offering is to be done with flowers brought by one's own self at the altar, according to the rites prescribed by sages. Hence, living in a forest is a hardship."

glosses.meaning: according to the rites prescribed by sages

verses.devanagari:
यथालब्धेन कर्तव्यः सन्तोष्स्तेन मैथिलि |
यताहारैर्वनचरैः सीते दुःखमतो वनम्
verses.iast:
yathālabdhena kartavyaḥ santośhstena maithili |
yatāhārairvanacaraiḥ sīte duḥkhamato vanam
verses.translation: "Oh, Sita the princess of Mithila! The dwellers of forest are to be satisfied with whatever is obtained there, the restricted food. Hence, living in forest is a misery.

glosses.itrans: Sita the princess of Mithila! vanacharaiH
glosses.iast: ṣita the princess of ṃithila! vanacaraiḥ

verses.devanagari:
अतीव वातः तिमिरम् बुभुक्षा च अत्र नित्यशः |
भयानि च महान्ति अत्र ततः दुह्खतरम् वनम्
verses.iast:
atīva vātaḥ timiram bubhukṣā ca atra nityaśaḥ |
bhayāni ca mahānti atra tataḥ duhkhataram vanam
verses.translation: "In the forest, air and darkness are too much. There are always hunger and great fears too. Hence, dwelling in a forest is very much a misery."

verses.devanagari:
सरी सृपाः च बहवो बहु रूपाः च भामिनि |
चरन्ति पृथिवीम् दर्पात् अतः दुखतरम् वनम्
verses.iast:
sarī sṛpāḥ ca bahavo bahu rūpāḥ ca bhāmini |
caranti pṛthivīm darpāt ataḥ dukhataram vanam
verses.translation: "Oh, Sita! Various creeping animals of different forms roam about on earth with pride. Hence dwelling in a forst is a great misery."

verses.devanagari:
नदी निलयनाः सर्पा नदी कुटिल गामिनः |
तिष्ठन्ति आवृत्य पन्थानम् अतः दुह्खतरम् वनम्
verses.iast:
nadī nilayanāḥ sarpā nadī kuṭila gāminaḥ |
tiṣṭhanti āvṛtya panthānam ataḥ duhkhataram vanam
verses.translation: "Snakes dwelling in rivers, moving crookedly like rivers, stay obstucting the pathways. Hence, living in forest is a great misery."

verses.devanagari:
पतम्गा वृश्चिकाः कीटा दंशाः च मशकैः सह |
बाधन्ते नित्यम् अबले सर्वम् दुह्खम् अतः वनम्
verses.iast:
patamgā vṛścikāḥ kīṭā daṃśāḥ ca maśakaiḥ saha |
bādhante nityam abale sarvam duhkham ataḥ vanam
verses.translation: "Oh, frail princess! Flying insects, scropious, insects including mosquitoes and files always annoy every one. Hence, forest is full of hardship."

verses.devanagari:
द्रुमाः कण्टकिनः चैव कुश काशाः च भामिनि |
वने व्याकुल शाखा अग्राः तेन दुह्खतरम् वनम्
verses.iast:
drumāḥ kaṇṭakinaḥ caiva kuśa kāśāḥ ca bhāmini |
vane vyākula śākhā agrāḥ tena duhkhataram vanam
verses.translation: "Oh, Sita! Forest is full of trees, kusa grass and bambooes with ends of their branches spread on all sides. Hence, living in a forest is a great misery."

glosses.meaning: with ends of branches spread on all sides

verses.devanagari:
कायक्लेशाश्च बहवो भयानि विविधानि च |
अरण्यवासे वसतो क्धुःखमेव ततो वनम्
verses.iast:
kāyakleśāśca bahavo bhayāni vividhāni ca |
araṇyavāse vasato kdhuḥkhameva tato vanam
verses.translation: "An inhabitant living in a forest has to face various bodily troubles and panics. Hence, forest- life is readly a misery."

verses.devanagari:
क्रोधलोभे विमोक्तव्यौ कर्तव्या तपसे मतिः |
न भेतव्यम् च भेतव्ये नित्यम् दुःखमतो वनम्
verses.iast:
krodhalobhe vimoktavyau kartavyā tapase matiḥ |
na bhetavyam ca bhetavye nityam duḥkhamato vanam
verses.translation: "Anger and greed are to be abandoned by the dwellers of forest. Devotion is to be bestowed on asceticism. What needs to be feared, should not be feared. Hence, living in a forest is a suffereing."

verses.devanagari:
तत् अलम् ते वनम् गत्वा क्षमम् न हि वनम् तव |
विमृशन्न् इह पश्यामि बहु दोषतरम् वनम्
verses.iast:
tat alam te vanam gatvā kṣamam na hi vanam tava |
vimṛśann iha paśyāmi bahu doṣataram vanam
verses.translation: "Therefore, do away with the idea of your coming to the forest. Forest is not indeed bearable for you. Reflecting now, I perceive forest as having too many disadvantages."

verses.devanagari:
वनम् तु नेतुम् न कृता मतिस् तदा |
बभूव रामेण यदा महात्मना |
न तस्य सीता वचनम् चकार तत् |
ततः अब्रवीद् रामम् इदम् सुदुह्खिता
verses.iast:
vanam tu netum na kṛtā matis tadā |
babhūva rāmeṇa yadā mahātmanā |
na tasya sītā vacanam cakāra tat |
tataḥ abravīd rāmam idam suduhkhitā
verses.translation: As the great souled Rama did not agree to take her to the forest, the much aggrieved Sita spoke to Rama as follows:-
